founderAsks.text: Create github.com/Capx-AI/terminal when you want the repo public. Do not ask Grok to push until you say so.
Create the Vercel project and point terminal.capx.ai. Localhost v1 does not need this.
When casa.capx.ai DNS is live, tell Terminal the production CASA_API. Until then mock :4201 then local :8787.
Freeze or take down the old Terminal Vercel+Neon /api/attest/* registry. Do not migrate those tables into this folder. Disposition is freeze.
Confirm Vercel serverless can GET https://api.launchpad.capx.ai. If it cannot, you supply a proxy. Localhost Grok will fetch it from this machine.
Connect Casa stays Launchpad-only. Do not ask Terminal to build a bind UI. Sample companies must not ship as production truth.
Export CODEX_API_KEY in the shell that runs web/server.mjs (Codex / defined.fi subscription). Do not put it in git. Restart :4200 after. Same key later on Vercel as an env var, not a file.
